title: Earn From Home
intro: A stranger writes to you about a job you never applied for. The pay sounds amazing.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

notify.text: Earn ₹3,000 daily from home, no experience…

banner.text: Message request · you do not follow this account

screen.context: You have not applied for any job.

msg: Just 1 hour a day on your phone.

dmfirst.label: They messaged first
dmfirst.lens: You never applied. A stranger found you.
dmfirst.why: Real recruiters rarely start with a cold DM offering instant pay.

pay.label: Big pay for little work
pay.lens: ₹3,000 a day for one hour a day.
pay.why: Big pay for little work is almost always a scam.

noexp.label: No experience, no interview
noexp.why: Real jobs check who you are. A job with no check is bait.

move.label: Move to another app
move.lens: They want you off this platform, where you can report them.
move.why: Scammers move you to private chat fast.

link.label: A link to a chat
link.lens: It goes to a private chat link, not a company site.
link.why: A real employer has an official careers page.

parttime.label: "Part-time work from home"
parttime.why: The kind of job is normal. What matters is how they hire.

actions.label: Message Anya on the messaging app
Look for a real company page and search the recruiter's name with "scam"

block_report.line: Blocked and reported. The platform removed the fake recruiter before it reached more people.

verify.line: A search of the name showed other people warning about the same "recruiter". Case cracked.

ignore.line: You stayed safe. But the same scam is still landing on other people.

go_ahead.line: Anya sent you to a "task" job. It started well, then asked for money to continue.

what_if.go_ahead: Searching the name with "scam" takes a minute. No honest job pays this much without an interview.
what_if.ignore: Reporting takes two taps and helps protect other people.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: Big pay for little work, from a stranger, with no interview, is a scam. Look for the company's own careers page.

quick_check.q: A stranger DMs you about a work-from-home job paying ₹3,000 a day, no interview. What do you do?

options.text: Ignore it, or block and report. Look only at real companies' own careers pages

quick_check.explain: Big pay for little work, with no interview, is the pattern.

hints.nudge: Why would anyone pay that much with no interview?
